parts.text: What is the immediate field recovery protocol when a cashier encounters an ERR-PAY-4001 EMV contactless payment freeze, and how do we ensure the customer is not double-charged?

To recover from an ERR-PAY-4001 EMV payment freeze on the Toshiba TCx 810, perform the certified field recovery protocol: 1. Power cycle the contactless payment terminal reader. 2. Verify in the register journal that the transaction was voided or aborted before initiating a new charge to prevent double-charging.
